customers_merge_metadata_check.name: customers_merge_metadata_check
customers_merge_metadata_check.value: ("customers"."merged_into_customer_id" IS NULL AND "customers"."merged_at" IS NULL AND "customers"."merged_by_business_member_id" IS NULL) OR ("customers"."merged_into_customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."merged_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."merged_by_business_member_id" IS NOT NULL)

notification_outbox_lock_state_check.name: notification_outbox_lock_state_check
notification_outbox_lock_state_check.value:
(
        ("notification_outbox"."status" = 'PROCESSING' AND "notification_outbox"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_outbox"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("notification_outbox"."status" <> 'PROCESSING' AND "notification_outbox"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "notification_outbox"."locked_by" IS NULL)
      )

notification_outbox_processed_state_chec.name: notification_outbox_processed_state_check
notification_outbox_processed_state_chec.value:
(
        ("notification_outbox"."status" = 'PROCESSED' AND "notification_outbox"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("notification_outbox"."status" <> 'PROCESSED' AND "notification_outbox"."processed_at" IS NULL)
      )

notification_plans_reminder_shape_check.name: notification_plans_reminder_shape_check
notification_plans_reminder_shape_check.value:
(
        ("notification_plans"."type" = 'APPOINTMENT_REMINDER' AND "notification_plans"."reminder_offset_minutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 43200 AND "notification_plans"."source_outbox_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("notification_plans"."type" <> 'APPOINTMENT_REMINDER' AND "notification_plans"."reminder_offset_minutes" IS NULL AND "notification_plans"."source_outbox_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

notification_plans_cancelled_state_check.name: notification_plans_cancelled_state_check
notification_plans_cancelled_state_check.value:
(
        ("notification_plans"."status" = 'CANCELLED' AND "notification_plans"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("notification_plans"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "notification_plans"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
      )
